overview: BTS: Burn the Stage follows the 300-day journey of the band's sold-out world tour, 2017 BTS Live Trilogy Episode: The Wings Tour. This show is an intimate, personal portrayal dedicated to each other and to their fans across the globe. It celebrates the triumph of their friendship as they overcome shared hardships, and shows the growth and hard work as BTS continues on the path to grow into fully-fledged artists.
title: BTS: Burn the Stage

overview: Guri Solberg and Olaf Tufte have gone to the mountains to give the viewers good Easter eve. They have brought famous guests for good conversations and Easter activities. In the ski slope, skiers and boarders show us Easter's most beautiful skiing and we meet one of the mountain heroes - the volunteers who make sure we are safe and safe at Easter eve.
title: Påskefjellet

overview: Chevaleresk, the lifestyles program deepened in male style, is back. After the first season, Måns Zelmerlöw and Alexander Wiberg were nominated by the viewers of the TV award Kristallen as "Best Man Program Manager of the Year". Then through the series they had portrayed the modern gentleman. Now they are heading for a roadtrip in Sweden and Europe to explore typical Chevalar activities.
title: Chevaleresk

overview: In Hemliga beundrare we follow people who are finally daring to take the step and confront the people they've secretly admired for ages. How will the surprise date go and will sparks fly?
title: Hemliga beundrare

overview: The usually bright teacher Xiao Shui Guang becomes depressed after losing her boyfriend. Because of an incident at school, she gets to know the older brother of one of the students Zhang Zheng Lan, who is the boss of a games company. Zheng Lan discovers that Shui Guang is the one who once gave him the idea for a game and starts to pursue her. He soon realizes that she closed herselfoff and thus promises her: "You protect your secret and I will protect you."
title: To Love, To Heal

overview: Series following demolition crews as they smash, crush and blast their way through the UK's unwanted buildings.
title: Demolition

overview: Nan Qiao has an ugly breakup with cheating fiance Zhou Ran, who then withdraws all his capital from her drone designing business and prevents other potential investors from funding the company. Shi Yue decides to invest in Nan Qiao's company after discovering that she may be the reason why he went from aspiring soldier to gigolo and nightclub owner. However Shi Yue's revenge plans fall by the wayside when he develops romantic feelings for Nan Qiao.
title: Only Side by Side with You

overview: In this one-season series based on two high-rated TV movies, Carl Kolchak is a down-and-out reporter who finds himself in Chicago. He gets a job with the Independent News Service, and finds himself investigating cases involving the supernatural and the fantastical.
title: Kolchak: The Night Stalker

overview: Two huge personalities, one incredible ambition, a series of set-piece challenges and a whole heap of conflict all make for an unforgettable series. Abbey Clancy is a girl with ambition. After a crack at the modelling business in the UK she's got her sights set on bigger and better things: the US. And who better to assist her than the woman who put the super into supermodel, the legendary Janice Dickinson.
title: Abbey and Janice: Beauty and the Best

overview: A sitcom where Benny Hill played a different role every week.
title: Benny Hill

overview: Jimmy Carr presents a selection of the world's funniest and weirdest TV adverts.
title: Commercial Breakdown with Jimmy Carr

overview: Series celebrating 1980s pop culture.
title: I Love the 1980s

overview: Myleene Klass and Nick Knowles host the search for Britain's best choir.
title: Last Choir Standing

overview: Series of one-off dramas.
title: The Afternoon Play

overview: After Peter Bonamy suffers a heart attack, and subsequently leaves hospital, he leads his life more carefully than before. His wife Jane and daughter Rosemary molly-coddle him, and he also attends a heart-attack survivors group. Bonamy, from the comfort of his south London home, finds himself doing little, especially as he can not even drive his Porsche.
title: Affairs of the Heart

overview: Claire Darrow, a lawyer, fights for what's right, regardless of whether it makes her a dime. Joanna, Claire's estranged mother and a lawyer as well, would rather make a profit. They clash on nearly everything, even on the best way to raise Claire's daughter, Louise.
title: Darrow & Darrow

overview: Jonathan Ross travels to Japan, Hong Kong and Korea to explore the world's most innovative cinema. He meets Asia's most talked about actors and directors and shares his passion for all aspects of Asian filmmaking with a multitude of clips.
title: Jonathan Ross' Asian Invasion

overview: General knowledge quiz show with a big cash prize.
title: The Vault

overview: Help concerns a psychotherapist and his therapy sessions with a variety of patients.
title: Help

overview: Forged in Fire: Knife or Death features fearless competitors as they race against the clock putting their blades and blade-wielding skills through a grueling gauntlet of challenges such as slicing through flying watermelons, hacking through massive ice blocks and severing various types of ropes, tubes, metals and item-filled crates.
title: Forged in Fire: Knife or Death

overview: Крещение Руси (The Birth of a Nation) features a wonderful period in the history, associated with the advent and spreading of Christianity in the territory of ancient Rus. The viewers will learn how the views and religious beliefs of the people of that time was evolving and what whey consisted of, how political mentality was changing, how what we know now as the Old Russian culture and spirituality – the things that shaped the great Holy Russia with its millennial history and uninterrupted connection with the present day – was being born.
title: Крещение Руси

overview: Jenny Zigrino loves history and hates the patriarchy, as do her guests, badass women from across time.
title: Badass Bitches of History

overview: Despite their mismatched styles, police officer partners Hubert and Staller rely on teamwork as they investigate murder cases in rural Bavaria. From seasons one through seven, the series was called Hubert and Staller. After Helmfried von Lüttichau left, the title was changed to Hubert ohne Staller.
title: Hubert ohne Staller

overview: At Longyearbyen in Svalbard lies the last Norwegian coal mine still in operation - Mine 7. In the series about one of Norway's toughest jobs, we follow a fused gang of miners. We get to know a small group of people, where good friendship and loyalty can really mean the difference between life and death.
title: Kompani Spitsbergen

overview: Documentary series following Rev Christine Musser in her Cornish parish.
title: A Seaside Parish

overview: Deals, Wheels and Steels follows six car dealers compete against each other to win the best bargain car and sell it on for a profit.
title: Deals, Wheels and Steals

overview: An aspiring hair designer named Hye Ni and an unemployed candidate named Chang Gyoon have a chance meeting at the newly opened "Momo Salon!"
title: Momo Salon

overview: Xiao Jun slowly wakes up from a train accident. Losing all her memories and left with amnesia, Xiao Jun has no idea who she is or where she is going. Yet the ancient ring that she is wearing on her finger is proof of being the Du family's eldest son's fiancé. Therefore, Xiao Jun is confusingly brought to the rich and powerful Du family. The head of the Du family treats her and loves her as if she is his own daughter, causing the pregnant Xiao Jun to experience the feelings of a warm family that she has never felt before.
title: Magic Ring

overview: Nampeung, a teacher on a district school, faces lots of problems when she is unable to secure herself a permanent position in her district school, and her father contracts a disease that affects his eyesight. Moreover, her father takes a mortgage for the property by striking a deal with Sia Songyod, and if she can't pay back on time, her property will be occupied or she has to be the mistress ofSia Songyod. Her father's friend, who works with Terd, advises her to work with Terd by teaching Naan, Terd's son. But Terd has a drinking addiction and Naan is aggressive.
title: Mon Rak Asun

overview: The Glamour Girls tells the story of two young women - Veronica and Debbie - who quit their jobs and decide to work as promotional girls at an agency. They quickly realise that life in sales is not as glamorous as they'd hoped it would be.
title: The Glamour Girls

overview: Set in Sydney beach suburb of Manly, New South Wales, Out of the Blue is a drama about a group of thirty-year-old friends returning home for a high school reunion, which is brought to an end when someone is murdered. An investigation follows as the group attempts to discover which one of them was the killer.
title: Out of the Blue

overview: Kerry Katona: Crazy in Love follows her and husband Mark Croft as they prepare for the birth of their baby.
title: Kerry Katona: Crazy in Love

overview: Yoon Tae Woon is a man who believes in living truthfully, so he is honest to a fault. On the other hand, Yoo Ji Na is a woman who has no qualms about lying to get what she wants. She is just starting out at a corporate job, determined to succeed at any cost. The drama will demonstrate how their unlikely romance turns out to be true love.
title: My Unfortunate Boyfriend

overview: Lively contemporary spin-off from the hugely successful ITV series The Royal, set in the same Yorkshire hospital 40 years on.
title: The Royal Today

overview: A woman entering a prison trying to establish her own justice. These women who are forced to give up their freedom are struggling in Karakuyu against their own order and their own laws.
title: Avlu

overview: Dinosaur Britain explores the amazing story of how dinosaurs one roamed Great Britain. The show will reveal how these creatures hunted, what they ate and how they died from the evidence revealed in their bones. Presenter Ellie Harrison and palaeontologists Dean Lomax attempt to bring dinosaurs back to life in Britain.
title: Dinosaur Britain

overview: A story about the love and growth of young people who work in a pub.
title: Love Pub

overview: Ellie Allard is a typical teenager with a passion for art, she gets up to loads of trouble with her best friends, goth Nadine and flirty Magda.
title: Girls in Love

overview: This series will document what life is like at Portland Young Offenders Institution in Dorset and follow Ian's work to help the inmates create their own football academy to play in, instilling them with a sense of pride, achievement and motivating them towards a better future. They will also be taught essential life skills and given positive role models as an example of how their futures can be changed for the better.
title: Football Behind Bars

overview: Dr. Adam Rutherford tells the extraordinary story of the scientific quest to discover the secrets of the cell and of life itself.
title: The Cell

overview: Ben Turner is a happily married man in his late thirties who owns a used book shop and helps his wife run an inn in a small town in England. When a young local girl is found murdered in the woods, Ben has more than the safety of his own daughter to worry about. For his real name is Peter Baxter, and in his late teens he was convicted of child murder and spent years in prison. Now a woman moves into the inn and starts asking pointed questions.
title: Forgotten

overview: Adam Curtis explores the origins of our contemporary idea of freedom.
title: The Trap: What Happened to Our Dream of Freedom

overview: The story of the Crusades is remembered as a tale of religious fanaticism and unspeakable brutality, but using fresh evidence, Dr. Thomas Asbridge re-examines this medieval drama.
title: The Crusades

overview: David Reynolds, Professor of International History at Cambridge University, uncovers the fascinating behind-the-scenes story of three ground-breaking summit meetings that have shaped the modern world.
title: Summits

overview: Join wildlife cameraman, Gordon Buchanan, as he tries to gain the trust of a wild bear family in a spectacular American wilderness.
title: The Bear Family and Me

overview: Tony Robinson and science journalist Becky McCall step into the unknown to investigate whether past paranormal events should be taken seriously or dumped into history's litterbin.
title: Unexplained

overview: Nicholas Crane rediscovers the 'lost' masterpiece Britannia on an epic 5000 mile hike battling the elements in search of Elizabethan Britain.
title: Nicholas Crane's Britannia: The Great Elizabethan Journey

overview: Eight ordinary people are given a million dollars and a fortnight of intensive training to run their own hedge fund. Hedge fund manager Lex van Dam wants to see if they can beat the professionals.
title: Million Dollar Traders

overview: Three television and music personalities, Mike Reid, Malcolm McLaren and Suzanne Shaw, head to Gardenstown, Banffshire, near Aberdeenshire in the North East of Scotland. Their aim was to become a part of the fishing village within the two weeks they were living in Gardenstown. After trying to become part of the community the 1000 local villagers took part in a secret ballot to vote for one of the three celebrities to become the Laird with the title The 13th Baron of Troup.
title: The Baron

overview: When Laura Crowe becomes tired of her devoted husband Will, she turns her affections to his best friend Adrian. With Will busy with his job as a headmaster, he hasn't noticed that Laura is playing away. However, it's a different story for the children of both Laura and Adrian who soon uncover the harsh truth that could destroy their families.
title: Little Devil

overview: Rageh Omaar investigates the life of the man considered by Muslims to be the prophet responsible for the final revelation of Islam as well as the spread of the Muslim faith.
title: The Life of Muhammad

overview: Fiona Bruce fronts this eye-opening new three-part series on the stories behind Britain's official royal residences: Buckingham Palace, Windsor Castle and Palace of Holyroodhouse.
title: The Queen's Palaces

overview: For the past five years, Shaun Foggett and his wife Lisa have lived with their young family and a collection of crocodiles at their home in Whitney, Oxfordshire. This series follows Shaun's five-month journey as he gives up life as a carpenter to follow his dream of opening the UK's first crocodile zoo.
title: Croc Man

overview: In three hard-hitting programmes, Hugh Fearnley-Whittingstall explores the horrors of intensive chicken farming. The journey takes him far from the cosy lifestyle of River Cottage and into the harrowing conditions of running his own modern poultry production line.
title: Hugh's Chicken Run

overview: A group of lesbians living in London let cameras follow their lives as they work hard and party harder in and around the Soho establishment.
title: Candy Bar Girls

overview: Boxing superstar and devout Muslim, Amir Khan turns Mentor in this exciting, inspirational new series. Amir takes eight young men under his wing, drawn from some of Britain's most deprived areas, and puts them through his very own transformation programme. The young men have the privilege of observing Amir at close quarters, drawing inspiration from how he lives his life. This series is a truly transformational journey for all involved.
title: Amir Khan's Angry Young Men

overview: David Cassidy is a young police officer who uses his deceptive appearance to go undercover in places where older police couldn't pass.
title: David Cassidy - Man Undercover

overview: Mike Tyson: Raw and Uncut looks at Mike Tyson's unprecedented rise to the pinnacle of world boxing.
title: Mike Tyson: Raw and Uncut

overview: Cursed is told through the eyes of Nimue, the Lady of the Lake character from the King Arthur legend. Nimue is a teenager with a mysterious gift, and the series shows how she came to be on the road to her destiny. After her mother dies, Nimue joins a young mercenary named Arthur, on his quest to find the magician Merlin and deliver an ancient sword. The future Lady of the Lake become a symbol of courage and rebellion against the terrifying Red Paladins, and their complicit King Uther.
title: Cursed

overview: Comics, Anime and Games are now a globally popular form of entertainment from Japan. This 30 minute magazine program features Japan's ranking of the most popular titles from each genre. The program also has long interviews with Japan's top creators, as well as delivering information on upcoming related events.
title: imagine-nation

overview: Carsten Borchgrevink has an impetus that promises to be an unknown sailor to become the great hero. He led the world's first winter expedition expedition in Antarctica in 1898. Through a trip back to his cabin on the stormy Cape Adare, we will reveal why Carsten Borchgrevink ended up being poor and unknown.
title: Den glemte polarhelt

overview: This is a show about people that are still virgins, despite being of age for a long time. The show tells the story of people on their way to losing their virginity.
title: Ik Heb Het Nog Nooit Gedaan

overview: Adventurous adventure story, the main characters of which are two smart swindler - He and She. Two elegant, educated, quite respectable people who are engaged in enchanting scams.
title: Идеальная пара

overview: From Japan's most famous haiku locations, Haiku Masters introduces Photo Haikus sent in from around the world with its unique take on the art form, creating the ultimate social haiku experience.
title: Haiku Masters

overview: Join Jan Scherman on a long journey through the Swedish powerline.
title: Länge leve demokratin

overview: Its time to Bake, Decorate and Celebrate! you're invited to celebrate all of the occasions in your life with sweet treats. No prior experience needed — cake decorating has never been so easy and fun with hosts Nancy Siler. Each week includes a feature theme and specialty cakes for that occasion plus adaptations for other events. We also have a second related project with other ideas for that celebration. And last we feature a third project with related ideas for that special party. Each week also features 2 tips. The first is Decorating Basics — easy first steps for successful baking. The second tip — is actually a "decorating" tip! We feature a different cake decorating tip each week and easy instructions on how to achieve beautiful designs with just that tip. Make every day a party with Bake Decorate Celebrate!
title: Bake Decorate Celebrate!

overview: One of the most unique crime solvers on television, eccentric neuroscience professor Dr. Daniel Pierce, is recruited by the FBI to help solve complex cases. Dr. Pierce possesses an intimate knowledge of human behavior and a masterful understanding of the way the mind works. Although Pierce's mind may be brilliant, it's also damaged, as he suffers from paranoid schizophrenia.
title: Perception

overview: Drama series featuring writer Douglas Adams's holistic detective Dirk Gently, who operates based on the fundamental interconnectedness of all things.
title: Dirk Gently

overview: Yukimasa Yugami is a detective who chases after facts in cases. He will resort to illegal investigations and he uses his unique reasoning powers. His partner is rookie detective Torao Hanyu.
title: Keiji Yugami

overview: On NTV - an acutely social talk show "DNA". The heroes of the program are ordinary families, for whom a DNA test is the only way to end bitter disputes between relatives. Thanks to the genetic examination, program guests have the opportunity to establish paternity and demand payment of alimony, confirm kinship and reunite with relatives, identify legal heirs and learn more about their ancestry. Any person who finds himself in a difficult life situation can become a hero of the program and take a DNA test for free.
title: ДНК

overview: The story of a man's struggle to atone for a crime committed in youth. It results in his discovery of a new way of life.
title: Resurrection

overview: A woman framed for murdering a pregnant woman in Spain is given a life sentence. Out after 18 years, she returns home to find the real killer.
title: Forever

overview: Survivor is the British reality game show based on the popular international reality franchise of the same name. The show follows the same general format as the other editions of the show. The players are split between two "tribes", are taken to a remote island and are forced to live off the land with meager supplies for an extended period of time. Frequent physical and mental challenges are used to pit the teams against each other for rewards, such as food or luxuries, or for "immunity", forcing the other tribe to attend "Tribal Council", where they must vote off one of their players. Once about half the players are remaining, the remaining players are merged into a single tribe, and competitions are on an individual basis; winning immunity prevents that player from being voted out. Most players that are voted out at this stage form the "Tribal Council Jury". Once down to two people, a final Tribal Council is held where the remaining players plead their case to the Jury as to why they should win the game. The jury then votes for which player should be considered the "Ultimate Survivor" and be awarded the grand prize of £1,000,000.
title: Survivor

overview: Sahir, who is in charge of abandoning the people who attempt to commit suicide due to Istanbul Security, finds Bilge who is a scientist woman with a notice coming to the phone one day.
title: Dip

overview: In this parody of cop shows, Chris Elliott plays... Chris Monsanto, U.S. marshal! There's no bad guy he won't shoot, no car he won't crash. Aided by fellow officers Brett and Susie, Chris takes on the toughest of the tough.
title: Eagleheart

overview: Having conquered China, comedian Paul Merton has his sights set on India, an astonishingly diverse country of one billion people. Paul intends to beat his own path around this enormous subcontinent, shunning the traditional tourist spots in favour of unexpected sights and surprising detours, to see ‘his India'.
title: Paul Merton in India

overview: Sitcom set in the advertising industry.
title: The Persuasionists

overview: When the body of an eight-year-old girl is discovered in a garden, the chain of events leading up to her death begin to merge. Six months earlier, and three couples embark on exciting new relationships, blissfully unaware of the tragic consequences.
title: The Children

overview: A very light-hearted series, which centres itself around the lives of two very likeable and warm characters, Bob and Rose. Bob is gay, and Rose has a boyfriend. They meet up by accident in a street one night, and their lives begin to slowly change, and a relationship begins to develop between them. But that's only just the beginning...
title: Bob & Rose

overview: Property expert Sarah Beeny takes on the biggest challenge of her career as she tries to save Rise Hall in East Yorkshire from ruin. She and husband Graham have lived in the stately home for the past 10 years and plan to transform it into a wedding and events venue in just nine months. On a shoe-string budget, they must tackle 97 rooms with rising damp, an acre of leaking roofs and a third of a mile of corridors.
title: Beeny's Restoration Nightmare

overview: The Adam and Joe Show was a sketch series featuring the talents of Adam Buxton and Joe Cornish. As well as starring in the show they also wrote and directed it. The series was filmed in their from their bedsit in Brixton, London.
title: The Adam and Joe Show

overview: Food is a magazine show that attempts to inform the public about everything they need to know about the food they buy and how it is produced. The series is filmed at the Laverstoke Park Farm and the presenters offer advise on most topical food subjects so that the viewers have the best consumer advice available and are also offered tips on the cheapest ways to fill their shopping trolleys.
title: Food

overview: As single mum, Louise Evans, is given a promotion at her bank only to be coerced into facilitating a £250 million internet bank theft. Wired is a thriller about bank fraud, what happens to our money behind the scenes in the world of "electronic banking", and the shadowy bank robbers who no longer operate with masks and sawn-off shotguns.
title: Wired

overview: Kate, a 37-year old woman wakes up after being in a coma for 18 years. Her boyfriend, Pete, from her younger days is with a new woman who bears an uncanny resemblance to Kate. Many of her friends have also moved on with their lives. But when she finds out that her comatose body was discovered near the lifeless body of a kid named Brian near a woodshed, her memories of that fateful night are triggered and the truth begins to surface.
title: The Time of Your Life

overview: Star Cops follows Nathan Spring and the rest of his multinational team of the International Space Police (Star Cops) as they work to establish the Star Cops and solve whatever crimes come their way. Operating in a relatively accurately realised hard SF, near-future, space environment, many of the cases that the Star Cops investigate arise from opportunities for new crimes presented by the technologically advanced future society the series depicts and from the hostile frontier nature of the environment that the Star Cops live in.
title: Star Cops

overview: In this adaptation of the mystery novels of the authors who wrote under the pen name Ellery Queen, 1940s amateur sleuth Ellery Queen helps his father, the chief of police, to solve baffling crimes. Each episode concludes with a "challenge to the viewers" presented by Ellery himself, asking who they think that the killer is. Ellery then gathers all the suspects and presents his case, and identifies the killer.
title: Ellery Queen

overview: Series following the daily lives of Britain's clean up teams, including pest controllers, restaurant inspectors and litter pickers.
title: Grimefighters

overview: Sketch show co-written by and starring comedian Karen Taylor. Expect a fresh and saucy look at modern life as Karen welcomes us to a world as seen through her irreverent and lascivious eyes.
title: Touch Me, I'm Karen Taylor

overview: Doctor in Charge is a comedy series based on a set of books by Richard Gordon about the misadventures of a group of doctors.
title: Doctor in Charge

overview: Build a New Life in the Country follows people leaving the rat-race of the city in pursuit of new lifestyles and new homes in the countryside. The dream houses they are creating are inspiring, architecturally challenging and are all undertaken with a modest budget.
title: Build a New Life in the Country

overview: Just months after a tragic loss, detective Sofia Karppi investigates the murder of a woman with ties to a Helsinki construction company.
title: Karppi

overview: Inaba Rika is a director at Teito TV Network. Ever since her childhood it was been her dream to be a reporter. Yet she frequently causes troubles due to her aggressive interviewing style and eventually gets transferred against her will to be the co-director of an evening information programme. She is put in charge of a special feature on uniformed personnel and ordered to interview the Self Defence Forces. First Lieutenant Sorai Daisuke became a fighter pilot but injured his foot in an accident and got assigned to a department which he was unprepared for, the Air Staff Office's Public Relations Department. Ever since the accident, he has never once shown his feelings. However, Daisuke's superior Sagisaka saw through his "benign, mild" facade and placed Rika in his care even though the people around him said he was still not ready for it. It chafes at Rika to have her dream destroyed and she psyches herself for a comeback as a reporter by getting a scoop. With that in mind, she is constantly provocative in her speech and conduct towards the members of the Public Relations Department, especially Daisuke. And she says something to Daisuke that she never should...
title: Soratobu Kouhoushitsu

overview: Food Exposed with Nelufar Hedayat will cover topics such as fish, dairy, water, GMOs, superfoods, palm oil, and pork. Hosted by award-winning journalist Nelufar Hedayat, the eye-opening series examines how our appetites shape our world, investigating the global food chain and the origins of our favorite ingredients. As she travels the world, Nelufar reveals the true cost of food to people, animals, and the planet. This ambitious, sometimes shocking and revelatory series spans the globe from the North Pole to China, the oceans of West Africa to the forests of Asia and explores the future of food and how we're going to feed our rapidly-expanding population.
title: Food Exposed with Nelufar Hedayat

overview: Anders Jansson loves English football. Therefore, "Between the Rows" is his dream program. And if you love English football as much as Jansson, you should definitely not miss this magazine. The perfect blend of laughter and football nerd.
title: Mellan Raderna
